The function implementation uses `max(frequency.values())` without checking if the `frequency` dictionary is empty first. If the input string `s` is empty, `frequency` will be an empty dictionary, and calling `max()` on an empty sequence will raise a `ValueError`. This is a classic edge case handling error where the agent assumes the input will always contain characters, ignoring the possibility of an empty string.
